falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the bottom pattern match, as the structure would no longer resemble a successful bottom formation and would instead confirm a breakdown to lower levels

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained volatility expansion beyond the August 2024 peak VIX levels (~28) would indicate panic selling rather than capitulation/bottoming, breaking the pattern of volatility contraction that characterized the 2024 August bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below 5,000
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination of flight-to-safety bid in bonds with equity weakness would signal recession fear rather than soft-landing/growth-recovery narrative, invalidating the bottom_2024_aug pattern which occurred alongside stabilizing/rising yields

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
